ma.getStorageSync(string key)

Synchronously obtain the content of a specified key from the local cache.

Parameter

string key

Specified key in the local cache.

Return Value

any

Content corresponding to the key.

Sample Code

function getStorage() {
    const key = 'key';
    try {
        const val = ma.getStorageSync(key)
        if (val) {
            // Do something with return val
        }
    } catch (e) {
        // Do something when catch error
    }
}

Bug & Tips

  1. tip:The maximum size of data transferred by getStorageSync on Android is 10 KB. If the size exceeds 10 KB, use the asynchronous API getStorage.
